info.title: OMA LwM2M Sensor Group Device Capabilities (Object ID 3461)

Sensor_Group_Device_Capabilities.label: Sensor Group Device Capabilities
Sensor_Group_Device_Capabilities.description: This object is used to notify the user about the capabilities supported by the device in respect to Distributed Sensot Group functionality.

Remote_Sensor_Management_capabilities.label: Remote Sensor Management capabilities
Remote_Sensor_Management_capabilities.description:
Specifies the capabilities supported by the device to manage and store remote sensors information retrieved from the sensor group as a Bit Mask:
Bit 0: Dynamic mapping support - Remote sensors can be discovered as new messages are received. If explicit mapping is required, new corresponding object instances will be automatically created
Bit 1: Implicit mapping support - Sensor state is maintained on an implementation specific internal database instead of being reflected into local objects
Bit 2: Auto clear support - Automatic clear to the default value is supported after validity time is expired

Max_number_of_explicit_sensors.label: Max number of explicit sensors
Max_number_of_explicit_sensors.description:
The maximum number of sensors and sensor states the device can instantiate.
This value is calculated by the count of all different sensor objects associated with a sensor groups.
This value shall be set to 0 if explicit mapping is not supported
On uCiFi compliant devices support for static explicit mapping is mandatory.

Max_number_of_implicit_sensors.label: Max number of implicit sensors
Max_number_of_implicit_sensors.description:
The maximum number of sensors and sensor states the device can keep in memory.
This value is calculated by the count of all different sensor objects associated with a sensor groups.
This value shall be set to 0 if implicit mapping is not supported.

Data_Fusion_Capabilities.label: Data Fusion Capabilities
Data_Fusion_Capabilities.description:
Specifies the data fusion algorithms supported by the device represented as a bitmask:
Bit 0: OR
Bit 1: AND
Bit 2: ADD
Bit 3: MAX
Bit 4: MIN
Bit 5: LAST - The last value reported by any sensor in the group becomes the group state value
Bit 6: Reserved (Custom 1)
Bit 7: Reserved (Custom 2)
If the device supports no fusion capabilities, this resource should be set to 0.

Reset_DSG_objects.label: Reset DSG objects
Reset_DSG_objects.description: When executed, trigger a complete wipe of the distributed sensor groups already commissioned
